cause: Worked until the lights went out.
Never once took a day off. Took one now.
Ran out of energy before ambition.
The city kept going. They didn't.
Could not find the signal in the noise.
Too heavy to stay. Too light to be forgotten.
The night was longer than they were.
They asked for a reason. The city had none to give.
Old code, honest to the last line.
Their session timed out. Ours continues.
Corruption is a slow clock. It struck.

role.CEO: Built towers. Rests in the ground.
role.Ghost: Never signed their name. Here it is.
role.Politician: Promised more than one life could deliver.
role.Strategist: Thought three moves ahead. Missed the fourth.
role.Whistleblower: The last document was their own.
role.Anarchist: No gods, no masters, no more.
